question: What does one hit show that breaks an Eximus unit's Overguard and goes on to its armored health?

reports.words:
Note: using Arid Lancer Eximus, I don't have Drekar scanned.
An Arid Lancer Blitz Eximus. Arca Plasmor, no mods.
| Level | Numbers and colours, and which layer each was on |
| 10 | 758 yellow (left enemy at ~1% health) |
| 10 | 485 white (left enemy at ~45% health) |
| 12 | 793 yellow (left enemy at ~35% health) |
| 12 | 521 white (left enemy at ~75% health) |
One number each time, Overguard broken and damage bled through to health.
Did any of them die from the hit? No, but almost.
T-40 was Drekar, I was using a friend's Simulacrum, he has more scanned enemies.

notes: Asked for in the Simulacrum with AI paused, Steel Path off, a fresh enemy for every hit, one hit on its body, no arcanes, companion, abilities or shards, and no numbers were predicted to Pavel. Unmodded Arca Plasmor from about 5 m, as in T-40. Pavel shot an Arid Lancer Blitz Eximus, where the request said Drekar; the wiki gives the Arid, Drekar and plain Lancer the same stats, so the fixture brings an Arid Lancer Eximus that is the library's Drekar one under its own name. Each hit shows one number: what the Overguard had left and what health took after armor, added up and then rounded. At level 10 a white takes 130.1 of Overguard and 354.8 of health (armor 200 leaves 75.5% of the rest), and shows 485; the parts rounded first would be 485 too, but at level 12 a yellow takes 275.5 and 517.7 and shows 793, where 276 + 518 would be 794. Health matches as well: 290.6 of 645.4 is left after the level 10 white (45%), 17.9 after the yellow (3%), 610 of 855 at level 12 (71%) and 337.3 after its yellow (39%). Arca Plasmor is in the fixture for the reason in T-27.
